title: The Secret of the Floating Flower Garden
synopsis: Starting where Episode 14 ended, Melody waves goodbye ('Say hello to the flowers for me!') and the friends jump into the music box's image. They drop onto a floating flower island above a sparkling crystal lake, but the garden is fading: giant flowers are closing, colours are draining, islands are drifting apart, butterflies are disappearing and the lake's waves have gone still. Bobo spots a banana-shaped flower ('Do they grow banana trees here?'), Kiko warns it might bite, it twitches and Bobo hides behind tiny Lumi; Draco, who 'knows everything about flowers', takes a long proud sniff of a giant pink flower and sneezes himself into a yellow pollen cloud. A wiggling pink flower opens and out pops Petal, a tiny flower fairy and guardian of the garden: the Bloom Crystal has stopped shining. She tries to show her flower magic, sneezes, and a petal storm buries everyone ('Bobo, I think you've become a walking flower!' 'At least I smell delicious!'). Hopping across lily pads to the island of giant flowers, Bobo hugs a giant 'banana' that blooms into a flower in his arms, Kiko secretly crowns Draco with flowers ('Behold! I am the Flower Dragon!') until a flower lands on his nose and he sneezes into a somersault, and Petal's next sneeze floats everyone into the air. At the flower gate on the lake, Lumi reads the glowing order (pink, yellow, blue, purple), Kiko taps a flower that launches Bobo into a petal cloud ('I came to save a garden, not become gardening equipment!'), Draco's tiny flame makes another flower snap shut in a huff, and the four pollen orbs open the gate. In the chamber under the lake the crystal is dark and Petal fears her magic is gone; Lumi encourages her, the friends set the orbs, and Petal grows a rainbow flower whose light restores the Bloom Crystal; a flower bounces Bobo up ('I think the flowers are trying to eat me!'). The whole garden blooms again: waterfalls flow, butterflies return, the lake sparkles, Kiko jumps out of a flower ('Surprise!'), Draco's heroic landing ends in a pile of petals, and a golden banana flower gently closes around Bobo's paw.
ending: The restored Bloom Crystal projects an island in the stars, surrounded by glowing stars and floating lanterns. 'An island in the stars? I wonder what magic is waiting there!' Next: The Secret of the Starlight Island.
newCharacters: Petal, a tiny pink-and-lavender flower fairy and guardian of the Floating Flower Garden: large emerald-green eyes, delicate translucent butterfly wings, a tiny flower-shaped crown, a soft petal dress (pink outer petals over lavender), lavender petal hair, small glowing floral patterns around her hands and a tiny glowing flower on her forehead; friendly, gentle and cheerful, loves flowers and butterflies, can make flowers bloom, sneezes when she smells too much pollen and her sneezes make colourful petal storms (she gets embarrassed and covers her cheeks); learned her magic was inside her all along (Petal in src/ep15/props.tsx, voice bf_alice pitched 1.25)
